page_title: OSA 2-2 VIL | Osasuna v Villarreal 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Sergio Herrera no chance!
90+3' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is going to take the penalty!
90+2' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) earns the yellow card.
90+1' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+1' Osasuna concede a free kick following a bad challenge. PENALTY to Villarreal! Let's see who will take responsibility.
90+1' The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero has finally had enough of Vicente Moreno and brandishes a yellow card at him!
87' Ante Budimir goes off the pitch and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) comes on.
86' That's the end of the game for Aimar Oroz, who is replaced by Abel Bretones (Osasuna).
86' Marcelino prepares a substitution. Yeremy Pino is replaced by Pau Cabanes (Villarreal).
86' 0:7 – the corner kicks stats. Fouls committed – 10:13.
84' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
84' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
82' Villarreal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Villarreal win a corner.
81' Villarreal players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
78' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Bryan Zaragoza will be replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
77' Substitution. Sergi Cardona makes way for Juan Bernat (Villarreal).

77' Logan Costa (Villarreal) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
77' The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.

76' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Sergio Herrera, who pulls off a stunning save! Good work from Villarreal as they win a corner.
75' Caution goes to Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
74' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
72' It is time for a substitution. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) is on for Santi Comesana.

72' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
71' Osasuna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
67' 2 - 1 Goal! Yeremy Pino feeds Alex Baena (Villarreal), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:1.
66' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Jon Moncayola and he is replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
66' That will be all from Ruben Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
65' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Villarreal.
59' The referee signals a corner kick to Villarreal.
59' The ball is cleared after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
54' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.
52' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had an easy-decision to make.
52' The attendance for today's match is 19795.
51' That's a well-taken pass by Dani Parejo (Villarreal). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
50' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
49' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Dani Parejo (Villarreal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

48' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Sergio Herrera is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Villarreal.
46' Half-time substitution. Ramon Terrats is replaced by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag. Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
45+1' The yellow card is received by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal).
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' The referee gives a yellow card to Alex Baena (Villarreal).
45' Villarreal are ruled offside.
43' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
39' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) picks up a yellow card.
39' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) forces a pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
35' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Yeremy Pino (Villarreal), but Sergio Herrera is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
34' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' Logan Costa (Villarreal) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
32' Alex Baena (Villarreal) will take the free kick.
31' It must be a yellow card. It is. Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
29' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
28' NO PENALTY! Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Osasuna players are incensed.
28' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Osasuna as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
28' The players claim that Dani Parejo (Villarreal) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. The referee gives a penalty kick to Osasuna!!
25' Marcelino is stunned as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
25' A player from Villarreal pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
23' A player from Osasuna commits a rough challenge. Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Villarreal have a free kick.
20' 2 - 0 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Diego Conde into the bottom left corner.
20' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
19' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Raul Albiol (Villarreal) is given a yellow card.
18' It’s a PENALTY to Osasuna after the VAR review!

18' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Osasuna.
17' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Alex Baena (Villarreal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
14' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the bottom right corner after a good run and cross by Ruben Garcia.
8' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
6' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a throw-in.
4' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
3' Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) meets a cross inside the box, but Sergio Herrera wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
2' Some great controlled play and passing from Villarreal. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Ramon Terrats (Villarreal), but the defence gets it clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
Villarreal will kick the game off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
